mapper.sql: c.id, c.at, c.username, c.source, c.drawing_id, d.name as drawing_name, c.batch_id::text as batch_id, c.kind, c.target, c.target_key, c.before::text as before, c.after::text as after, c.reverted, c.reverted_by, c.reverted_at
mapper.insert: insert into change_log (username, source, drawing_id, batch_id, kind, target, target_key, before, after) values (#{r.username,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{r.source}, #{r.drawingId}, cast(#{r.batchId} as uuid), #{r.kind}, #{r.target,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{r.targetKey}, cast(#{r.before,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as jsonb), cast(#{r.after,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as jsonb))
mapper.select:
select from change_log c join drawing d on d.id = c.drawing_id
order by c.id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select from change_log c join drawing d on d.id = c.drawing_id where c.batch_id = cast(#{batchId} as uuid) order by c.id
mapper.update: update change_log set reverted = true, reverted_by = #{by,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, reverted_at = now() where batch_id = cast(#{batchId} as uuid) and not reverted
